title: StudioBrain Browse Views Schema
description: Browse-page view configuration for an entity type (SBAI-15043). Accepted as `views` in a *.layout.json file and in TEMPLATE.md frontmatter. Every key is optional: core infers whatever is absent (spec section 3). Precedence is per key: layout `views`, then template `views`, then legacy `grid_fields` / `list_layout`, then the category default, then inferred. Field keys are not checked against the template here; scripts/validate.py cross-checks shipped data.

default.description: View the browse page opens on. When it names a view that is not registered in the running edition (e.g. `map` in core), core falls back to the category default.

enabled.description: Views offered in the view toggle, in order. Unregistered ids are dropped by core at runtime. Absent: the category default plus conditional views (board/calendar/gallery/carousel) the fields allow.

roles.description: Which fields fill the card/list slots.

title.description: Card title. Default: `name`, else the first string field.

subtitle.description: Second line. Default: the next short string field.

image.description: Card/gallery image. Default: `primary_image`, else the first image field.

badges.description: Enum-like fields rendered as badges (at most 3).

card_fields.description: Scalar fields shown on the card body (at most 6).

columns.description: Table columns in order. A bare string is shorthand for {key}.

group_by.description: Enum field whose values are the board columns. Default: `status`, else the first enum.

columns.description: Optional column order (values of group_by). Values not listed follow in option order.

default.description: Initial sort. A string is a field key, `-key` sorts descending.

options.description: Sortable field keys offered in the sort menu.

facets.description: Filter facets (enum, boolean and tags fields).

^plugin:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*(?::[a-z0-9][.description: Configuration for a plugin-provided view, keyed by its view id.

viewKind.description: Browse view id. Core registers cards, list, table, gallery, carousel, board and calendar; cloud registers map and timeline; `plugin:<plugin>[:<view>]` is reserved for plugin views.

displayKind.description: How a table cell renders its value.

fieldKey.description: A frontmatter field key (dotted paths reach nested values). `updated` and `created` name the entity timestamps.
